meta.title: Hugo Fugeard · Private chef in the Alps and Annecy
meta.description: Private chef in ski chalets in winter: Courchevel, Méribel, Megève, Val d'Isère, Verbier and Gstaad. All year round, private chef in and around Annecy for dinners and events. French and Italian cooking.

hero.eyebrow: Private chef · French and Swiss Alps · Annecy
hero.title: Your private chef, wherever you are.
hero.text: In winter, find me in private chalets: Courchevel, Méribel, Megève, Val d'Isère, Verbier, Gstaad. The rest of the year, in your holiday rentals and in your own home: Annecy and the surrounding area. French and Italian cooking from the heart, served at your table.

offers.title: Two ways to work with me

items.title: In winter, in your chalet
items.places: Courchevel · Méribel · Megève · Val d'Isère · Verbier · Gstaad
items.text: A private chef for your ski holiday. Every meal or just the dinners, for a few days or the whole week.
items.message: Hello Hugo! We'd like a private chef for our chalet stay. Resort: ... Dates: ... Number of guests: ...

items.title: All year, in and around Annecy
items.text: A private chef for a dinner, a birthday or an event at your home.
items.message: Hello Hugo! I'd like to organise a meal at home. Place: ... Date: ... Number of guests: ... Occasion: ...

offers.note: And anywhere else in France, on request.

items.title: Discretion
items.text: What happens at your table stays at your table. I never photograph my clients or mention their names.

items.title: Made to measure
items.text: No set menu. Every menu is built with you, around your tastes and cravings, and the children's too.

items.title: I do the cooking
items.text: No stand-ins: I'm the one at the stove, from the first meal to the last.

items.title: Everyone eats well
items.text: Allergies, intolerances, vegetarian, gluten-free: every guest gets a plate designed for them.

about.title: About me
paragraphs: I'm a private chef. My job is to come to wherever you are, so the only thing you need to think about is the people around you.
French and Italian are the cuisines I love most: beautiful produce, honest flavours and carefully made dishes, from the great classics to more refined plates. If you have other cravings, I'll adapt.
One exceptional dinner or every meal of the week: I adapt to your stay, your tastes and the kitchen in the house.

approach.title: My work
approach.intro: Every group and every place is different. I adapt to every situation.

items.title: Family style
items.text: Dishes to share, served at the table. It's how I cook almost everywhere, because it's how people relax.

items.title: Made for you
items.text: Your tastes, your allergies, your kids' favourites. We build the menu together, and I cook for each person, not just the group.

items.title: Fancy or cozy
items.text: A full kitchen means more ambitious dishes. A simple kitchen means a warm, generous meal. Both are good.

process.title: How it works
process.intro: From the first message to the last dessert, here's what working together looks like.

steps.title: Say hello
steps.text: Tell me where, when, how many people, and what you're celebrating.

steps.title: Your proposal
steps.text: I send you a personal proposal for the days and meals you need.

steps.title: A deposit
steps.text: A deposit confirms your dates. Then they're yours.

steps.title: The menu, together
steps.text: We build the menus together. You approve them before I arrive.

steps.title: Groceries
steps.text: Ideally, groceries are delivered to the house. It gives me more time to cook. If not, I do the shopping.

steps.title: Sit back
steps.text: I take care of the kitchen. You take care of your people.

steps.title: Settle up
steps.text: At the end, we settle the groceries and any expenses, with every receipt.

items.question: What does a private chef actually do?
items.answer: I come to your house or holiday rental and cook for you during your stay: every meal, or just the big nights. I plan the menus with you, cook on site and serve at the table.

items.question: What if the kitchen is small or basic?
items.answer: No problem. I adapt the menu to the kitchen. A big oven and plenty of pots let me go fancier. A simple kitchen means a beautiful family-style meal.

items.question: Do you travel outside France?
items.answer: Yes. In winter I mostly work in resorts in the French and Swiss Alps. The rest of the year I cook in and around Annecy, and travel anywhere in France on request. Travel is included in your proposal.

items.question: The house is hard to reach. Is that a problem?
items.answer: Tell me where it is. We'll sort out the travel together, by car, pickup or a shared ride.

items.question: Allergies, diets, picky kids?
items.answer: Of course. Tell me about allergies, dislikes and kids' habits when we plan the menu. Everyone eats well.

items.question: Who buys the groceries?
items.answer: Home delivery from a local supermarket is ideal, because it gives me more time to cook. Otherwise I shop myself. Groceries are billed at cost, with receipts.

items.question: Do you also serve and clean up?
items.answer: I look after the kitchen and the food. For bigger groups, I can bring an assistant or a butler for service, glasses and cleaning. Available on request.

items.question: How much does it cost?
items.answer: Every stay is different, so I send a personal proposal. Write to me with your dates, the place and the size of your group.

partners.title: Do you manage chalets?
partners.text: Concierge services, rental agencies and owners in Courchevel, Méribel, Megève, Val d'Isère, Verbier or Gstaad: offer your guests a private chef. I plan the menus with them and cook on site during their stay.
